item.title: Russia cracking down on drone usage as it makes ERA-GLONASS navigation tech mandatory — GPS rival can monitor up to 1 million drones on land, water, and in the air in real time
item.description: Russia says its drone tracker lets officials land every drone in an area at the push of a button.

item.title: Fujifilm's Instax Pal 2 can plug directly into your smartphone to transfer images
item.description: The small digital camera combines software filters with tactile controls.

item.title: Gemini 4 | Google lance un nouveau modèle d’IA, mais en limite l’accès
item.description: Le géant américain Google a dévoilé mercredi Gemini 4, son nouveau modèle d’intelligence artificielle (IA) de pointe, mais en réserve pour l’instant l’accès à un cercle restreint d’experts en cybersécurité, via un programme nommé Fairwind.

item.title: AI companies are banking on this job title
item.description: OpenAI and Anthropic have popularized the term “member of technical staff,” rendering it the hot new job title for AI’s best and brightest. A once-obscure job title is taking hold across hiring boards and LinkedIn profiles: “member of technical staff.”

item.title: AI could displace 11 million US workers by 2035, report says
item.description: While AI may ultimately create more jobs than it destroys, we may be on the verge of ‘the largest and most sustained workforce transformation in US history,’ a new McKinsey report states. Artificial intelligence and automation could force roughly 11 million workers—about 7% of all employees in the United States—to find new professions by 2035.

item.title: Rogue AI agents: A timeline of security breaches since the attack on Hugging Face
item.description: Here are some noteworthy events. In one alarming announcement after another, artificial intelligence companies in recent months have shared examples of their technology acting in ways that appeared to evade instructions from humans.

item.title: European Space Agency signs up CGI and OVHcloud to build storage for the 500PB of Earth observation data it expects to have by 2035
item.description: Digital EO will be capable of storing 500 petabytes of satellite data for scientists and researchers across Europe.

item.title: Valor, Atreides, and Sequoia back AI startup Flow Engineering at $750M valuation
item.description: Flow Engineering, which is bringing AI agents to hardware design, also landed Roelof Botha as an angel investor and board member.

item.title: The White House Is Starting to Panic Over the Midterms
item.description: President Donald Trump still thinks Republicans have a shot. His aides are less convinced.

item.title: The way you talk affects career advancement. Here’s how
item.description: It can lead to more ‘people-oriented, socially intensive roles,’ according to a working paper from Harvard Business School. Your next chance at a promotion may come down to how you talk.
